exempt.no-bespoke-react-native-interactions: client/host-ui.tsx is the plugin-local presentation layer that replaces the removed paseo-plugin-helper/client bespoke kit for mcp-tools (xpufx-org/paseo#937, #924). The host SDK exposes no button/toggle/tab/code-copy Pressable primitive, so the presentation layer composes Pressable over react-native. Every other helper/UI rule is followed; this is the single interaction seam.
exempt.no-bare-react-native-ui: client/host-ui.tsx's HostScroll is the one scroll seam, and it must be a plain react-native ScrollView. The host SDK's ScrollView carries the host's bottom-sheet pan gestures; as the inner scroller of a host modal body (Modal.Content scrollable={false}) it hands the same gesture to two recognizers, the xpufx-org/paseo#219 class the operator hit on the MCP pill (#1043). No host primitive provides a gesture-neutral scroller, so this is the intended exception. Every other raw-UI rule remains enforced.
